method: Actual native diagnostic material-ID captures classify every source-scale RGB residual>1 by visible mesh category. Each actual Godot full-image residual bounding box>1 is checked against this exact native residual projection expanded by2 outputpixels for the common area-filter footprint. This is a localization diagnostic of actual output, not a simulated Godot rendering or an automatic acceptance threshold.
